name: Science
facts: Water can boil and freeze at the same time at a condition called the triple point.
Lightning is about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Thunder is the sound of air expanding explosively as lightning heats it.
Glass is an amorphous solid; its atoms are not arranged in a regular crystal pattern.
Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water, an effect named after Erasto Mpemba.
Diamonds and the graphite in pencils are both made of pure carbon.
Sound cannot travel through a vacuum.
Helium is the only element that cannot be solidified by cooling alone at normal pressure.
An atom is mostly empty space.
Light travels at about 300,000 kilometres per second.
Bananas are slightly radioactive because they contain potassium-40.
The Eiffel Tower can grow about 15 centimetres taller in summer as the iron expands in the heat.
Water expands when it freezes, which is why ice floats.
Oxygen is colourless as a gas, but liquid oxygen is pale blue.
Gold is so malleable that one gram can be beaten into a sheet about one square metre in size.
A teaspoon of soil can contain more microorganisms than there are people on Earth.
The scanning tunnelling microscope, invented in 1981, lets scientists image and even move individual atoms.
Mercury is the only metal that is liquid at room temperature.
The Earth's core is roughly as hot as the surface of the Sun.
DNA in a single human cell, stretched out, would be about 2 metres long.
Gallium is a metal that can melt in your hand.
Antibiotics were discovered by accident when Alexander Fleming noticed mould killing bacteria in 1928.
The pH scale measures how acidic or basic a substance is, from 0 to 14.
C. V. Raman won the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics for discovering how light scatters, now called the Raman effect.
A rainbow is actually a full circle; from the ground we usually see only part of it.
